scope: Positive and negative review of ZIP under pack-local POS-INV-26; initial findings are not exhaustive

criteria.observation: Manifest reverse dependencies and multiple concrete QWeb/mail/Claims/freight consumers are not individually traced.
Seven OPEN categories are not one row per effect with owner, exact source, before/after disposition, and acceptance.
Critical existing file modifications (inbound Linda XML, QWeb reports, Automation templates, cron, claims/dashboard) and exact migrations/rollback remain unplanned.
Default untouched modules and SQL/report consumers have no verified no-change or independence evidence.
Pack says BLOCKED and refuses code; POS-INV-26 still draft and INV-P16 is NOT_RUN, with no observed technical enforcement receipt.

findings.observed: Seven RP frontiers all OPEN; no effect-by-effect owner/path/disposition register has been populated. VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE and PROVEN_INDEPENDENT appear only as instructions, not actual accepted disposition rows.
findings.impact: No full direct/transitive closure or complete planned change set. The pack explicitly blocks code.
findings.closure: Create one current-revision source-to-consumer census; one row per material effect with owner, before/after behavior, exact file/action, dependency, security/data/recovery, and test; obtain owner acceptance.

findings.observed: Actual Logistics manifest reverse dependency closure includes direct dependents: admin_dashboard, automation, claims, commission, crm_bridge, documents, documents_native, security_base; CRM sync is downstream through security_base/crm_bridge. The file map is limited to four existing addons and does not disposition these consumers individually.
findings.impact: Transitive effect paths and exclusions are incomplete, including legal claim automation and transaction-derived dashboards.
findings.closure: Record change or source-evidenced no-change for all nine reachable dependent addons at exact HEAD; inspect runtime consumers as well as manifest reachability.

findings.observed: Existing delivery-order and pickup/delivery BOL QWeb layouts dereference doc.sale_order_id.company_id, while the selected contract permits real buyerless/company-known loads. All three report files are absent from the detailed file plan.
findings.impact: Buyerless physical paperwork may show missing/wrong source company or fail its intended audience semantics; carrier packet proofs incomplete.
findings.closure: Decide and plan explicit changes or evidence-backed exclusions for report_delivery_order.xml, report_bol_pickup.xml, report_bol_delivery.xml; add exact PDF/audience regression cases.

findings.observed: Existing carrier dispatch/delivery/BOL email templates use object.sale_order_id.company_id for email-from, names, and reply-to context. The map defaults Automation to untouched, and its specific templates have no accepted no-change disposition.
findings.impact: New buyerless/PO-only load messages may use blank or fallback business identity; audience/security and deliverability can diverge from Logistics.
findings.closure: Inventory the four affected Automation templates, prove they remain unreachable for buyerless operations or plan source-owner-safe templates/guards and role/mail tests.
findings.owner: Automation template owner + Logistics sender owner

findings.observed: Linda inbound automation filters mail.message.model only to purchase.order and sale.order. Adding a booking request and modifying linda_response.py alone does not deliver booking-bound messages into the evidence pipeline. The inbound XML is not in the file map.
findings.impact: Booking reply evidence is silently absent even when response model accepts the new source kind.
findings.closure: Owner must choose and plan exact booking inbox/thread routing, automation domain change or owned equivalent, receipt/correlation/replay tests, and mail ordering with no PO/SO regression.

findings.observed: The active dispatch-acknowledgment cron invokes load.action_send_dispatch_direct() after the threshold, resending the full carrier packet. The accepted Linda/Documents owner policy says packet acknowledgment reminders must not resend the full packet. RP-03 names cron generically but does not assign the exact correction and pre-code proof.
findings.impact: Real duplicate carrier packets, potentially including stale booking revision, can escape without a complete plan.
findings.closure: Account for _cron_check_dispatch_acknowledgments, its active ir.cron and templates; plan status-only followup, transport unknown-outcome guard, recipient and stale-revision regression.

findings.observed: The separate plasticos.dispatch transition writes state directly; load_bulk_update_wizard directly invokes load._transition; composer and direct send actions remain distinct. The package does not list each effective entrypoint with change/no-change and an exact enforcement hook.
findings.impact: An Export booking hold may be bypassed by a direct/wizard/cron or mail path.
findings.closure: Enumerate state/change and external-effect entrypoints; place owner-specified guard at all live paths with negative bypass tests, or prove unused paths disabled.

findings.observed: Freight RFQ creation requires both load company and load.transaction_id; SAL resolver and freight history also derive company/repeat-stream context from SO/transaction. These consumers are not individually disposed in the file-change map.
findings.impact: Buyerless or PO-only loads may encounter an unplanned abstention, blocked RFQ or incorrect freight-source identity.
findings.closure: Disposition freight_quote.py, sal_resolver.py, freight_history.py and rate_memory.py with allowed buyerless behavior and explicit tests; change only where justified.

findings.observed: The Claims addon hooks plasticos.document.create and auto-creates a claim and outgoing notification for certain document tags; it searches a transaction via load_id with limit=1. The owner plan does not give Claims a verified no-change or planned adaptation for many scoped evidence links.
findings.impact: One original/typed association migration may spur unintended claim side effects or misattribute claims; evidence changes have monetary/workflow ramifications.
findings.closure: Assess upload versus typed evidence association, exact trigger idempotency and no double claim/notification, buyerless cases and company isolation; obtain Claims owner disposition.

findings.observed: Commission sales dashboard uses a SQL transaction/load join and derives document status from verified/override flags, while proposed Documents replaces unscoped verification with typed scoped acceptance. The pack lacks a per-consumer change/no-change verdict.
findings.impact: Sales dashboard document status or source permissions may diverge even if Export itself displays correct scoped evidence.
findings.closure: Trace existing dashboard/commission read-only status; plan mapping or prove unchanged meaning plus SQL security tests.

findings.observed: The Documents addon has an active six-hour missing-doc cron driven by transaction create_date and a single-link compliance API that checks expiry but not current/superseded status; these exact data/cron consumers do not have a row-level change/no-change plan.
findings.impact: New scoped evidence may not clear existing reminders or may incorrectly mark old obligations satisfied; duplicative followups are possible.
findings.closure: Disposition transaction_docs.py, data/cron_missing_docs.xml, compliance_service.py and document state transitions; test per-source scoped expiry/override, reminder idempotency and old invoice/close behavior.

findings.observed: The global Load rule accepts company_id=False, and the Sales Rep rule keys visibility to sale_order_id.user_id. Company ownership change and buyerless loads can alter access while no actual-company backfill census or exact revised record rules exist.
findings.impact: Cross-company/missing-company load visibility and owner access are not proven safe.
findings.closure: Record actual source-company and role population; plan migration before stricter rule, verified role-specific access and negative ORM/SQL/report/email probes.

findings.observed: ACL grants base.group_user broad document create/write/unlink, while document.write accepts verified/override fields without enforcing the named manager-authoritative action; the candidate one-writer migration has no precise authorization/field-write migration and negative acceptance row.
findings.impact: A new typed business verifier could be bypassed by ordinary ORM writes, compromising verification authority.
findings.closure: Plan exact field-write guards, group permissions, native synchronization, old ACL behavior and negative direct-write/import/cron tests.

findings.observed: M0-M7 migration steps and EE-01..09 tests are desired proof plans, all NOT_RUN. Source counts, actual ambiguous-row populations, exact versioned migration paths (<next_version>), upgrade fixture and tested rollback/restore references are absent.
findings.impact: No deterministic full migration/rollback/upgrade plan can be frozen for existing tenant data.
findings.closure: Collect read-only legacy population census, module version/install graph and fixture evidence; produce exact migration scripts/path and recovery/negative proof in the pre-code plan, not code yet.

findings.observed: The map says not to modify Transaction, native Stock, Automation and Facility Profile by default. It does not provide the required per-consumer verified unchanged records, and Automation source demonstrably has affected message templates.
findings.impact: A no-change assumption would launder unresolved dependencies into code authorization.
findings.closure: Convert each no-change default into source-backed VERIFIED_NO_CHANGE/PROVEN_INDEPENDENT with exact tests, or a defined CHANGE row; include Admin Dashboard, Claims, Commission and CRM consumers.

findings.observed: ZIP source map pins Staging@04bd0594; current Staging HEAD advanced three commits to 78476d, changing seven CRM/material files. The listed Logistics/Documents owner files inspected here retain matching blob identity, but source currentness and any material-profile integration exclusion have not been recorded in the ZIP.
findings.impact: An operator could code against an obsolete baseline or assume changed source providers are independent without proof.
findings.closure: Freeze new source SHA and delta summary, revalidate affected owner/content dependencies; record explicit source-diff no-impact or change plan and restart review if further commits land.

findings.observed: The old proposed addon filetree contains conditional booking_revision.py and a load_extension.py description centered on bookings with individual loads, while selected v2.7 E2/J1/E3 roles are stated elsewhere. This is historical/design-only, but the pre-code plan does not resolve whether each proposed file is kept, replaced, co-located or excluded.
findings.impact: An implementation agent reading both paths could choose conflicting field ownership or create surplus files.
findings.closure: Record one final file-by-file realization map from E1-E4/J1-J2 to current target repo with exact retained/rejected file paths and no duplicate load/slot association.

findings.observed: POS-INV-26 remains a working DRAFT; INV-P16 is a written negative probe marked NOT_RUN; the ZIP declares code blocked but does not contain an accepted revision-bound complete-plan receipt or an observed technical gate preventing unplanned edits.
findings.impact: Human/operator blocking instruction is explicit, but automatic repo/agent fail-closed enforcement cannot be claimed.
findings.closure: Produce and review a complete plan at exact SHA, validate the negative probe through the approved execution host/CI owner, and independently observe deny of unplanned edits before claiming enforcement.

findings.observed: All seven EXP-IC contract handoffs have status NOT_ADOPTED and Enterprise tests are NOT_RUN. J1/J2 and the 12 command signatures are specified as non-installed targets.
findings.impact: No downstream code may treat proposed interfaces as callable contracts or owner-approved schema.
findings.closure: Obtain source-owner adopted interfaces at exact SHA, installed Odoo 19 Enterprise API proof, testing hooks and accepted migration/ACL plan, independently recorded before any authorized code.
findings.owner: Applicable cross-module source owners + Enterprise integrator

material_unknowns: Full direct/transitive source call graph and owner-reviewed no-change census
Installed Odoo 19 Enterprise registry, version pins and addon availability
Real tenant legacy load/document/mail population and safe migration counts
Independent runtime/host technical enforcement and negative-probe receipts
Canonical source-owner adoption and separately authorized implementation scope
authority_boundary: This is audit evidence, not a certified all-ripples-closed plan or an implementation grant.
